question_text: Describe the full-day activity timeline at DemoBooth_NVIDIA on 2025-12-08 (UTC). Identify the busiest time windows, any lulls, and quantify the peak crowd sizes versus the baseline. Write 3-5 sentences.

rubric: Peak head_count values are substantially higher than baseline of ~3
Overnight / early-morning hours show baseline/quiet activity

answer_text: On December 8, 2025, at DemoBooth_NVIDIA, the activity was relatively steady throughout the day, with significant peaks and lulls. The busiest time windows were from 10:00 to 11:00 UTC and 15:00 to 16:00 UTC, with average head counts of 60.01 and 70.11, respectively, and peak crowd sizes reaching up to 86. In contrast, the baseline activity during other hours was much lower, with average head counts hovering around 3.5. The early morning and late evening hours experienced the least activity, maintaining a consistent low average head count.
